column1: # Typing with no mode switch: English run together, English sentences, English
# beside Japanese, and tokens of code and commands. Written for floatype; not
# taken from another input method's tests or documents.
# by " | ". A space in <keys> is the Space key; an upper-case letter is typed
# with Shift. The keys are typed in a kana mode from an empty input and
# committed with Enter at the end; the answer is everything committed.
# run-together       English words typed with no space stay as typed.
# english-sentence   English words with spaces: Space after an English word
# english-japanese   English with spaces beside Japanese, which converts.
# token              commands, paths, addresses and names of code stay as typed.
# japanese-space     Japanese still converts on Space: nothing above may turn
#                    it into kana and a space.
